name: lucca_joins
doc: Crono leaves the Queen's chamber, back through the hall and the east tower down to the castle's main floor (loc 078); Lucca arrives ('Crono!'), the explanation scene (loc 06C and back) and she joins ($2980 = 00 02 80 01, storyline 10 -> 12). Crono free at the east tower's door in loc 078.
